async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Edit status' button to open the status edit form
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Edit status").click()
    # Wait for the UI to update, assuming a modal or form appears
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Find the input field for the status text using accessibility roles
    # Common roles might be 'textbox' or 'combobox'; try 'textbox' first
    status_input = page.get_by_role("textbox")
    # Fill the input with the desired status
    await status_input.fill("Enjoying life")
    # Find and click the save button using a case-insensitive substring match
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for the action to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
